title: Printable Mini Hiking Journal, Pocket Trail Log, Fold Booklet Zine, Hiking Stocking Stuffer, Hiker Gift, Hike Log PDF, Summit Log
description:
A tiny trail journal you print yourself. One sheet of paper, three folds and one cut make an 8-page booklet, 2.75 x 4.25 in (7 x 11 cm), that fits a shirt pocket. No glue. Every hike gets a short prompt to answer, like best view today, what I heard or trail snack verdict. Print it as often as you like: one per season, one per trip, or a few to slip into gifts.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Start page and a step-by-step fold and cut guide with print tips
- Day Hikes edition: 5 hikes with a prompt each and a 12-month hike tally
- Four Seasons edition: one hike for each season and a best-of-the-year page
- Trip edition: for one park or one weekend, a plan page, a packing tick list, days 1 to 3 and a remember-this page
- Peak and Summit edition: 5 summits with elevation, start, turnaround and back-at-car times
- Blank edition: lines and sketch boxes for your own prompts
- Gift edition: a note, a trail promise and 5 hikes
- A mini envelope and three gift tags to print and cut
- A prompt bank of 40 extra prompts
- Color-in covers: ridge, forest, lake and draw-your-own

WHAT YOU GET
- 12 pages, US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, to read the guide and prompts on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Distances in miles or km, climb in feet or meters
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
You need a printer, plain paper and scissors. Plain copy paper folds best; kraft or colored paper looks great for gifts, card stock is too thick. For personal use: print as many copies as you like for yourself and to give as gifts.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
sub: One sheet, three folds, one cut: a pocket-size hiking journal with a prompt for every hike.
